claim: A field study of 26 neighborhood grocery stores in a low-income Mumbai settlement (750,000+ transactions, 12,000+ customers) found about 12% of customers receive store credit in a month, they generate over 30% of store revenue, 78% of them shop only at the lending store, owners spend about 8 hours a week tracking and enforcing repayment, and only about half of surveyed owners keep written records.
